lines.text: Text with a note.1 More text with another2 and an end. A typesetting
system takes a description of a document and decides where every character
goes. It breaks paragraphs into lines, stacks the lines into pages and places
headings, notes and figures where the reader expects them. Each of these steps
follows rules that can be written down precisely, and a good program follows
Lines of a paragraph are chosen together rather than one at a time. The
program looks at every way of breaking the paragraph and picks the one whose
lines are spaced most evenly, avoiding hyphens on consecutive lines and very
loose lines next to very tight ones.
